title: Evidence
description: One evidence address opened from disk (jason.approvals.evidence.resolve; GET /api/evidence; the jason-mcp evidence tool). Nothing is read live: each copy says when it was read, and refresh names the commands that read it again. A miss is found false with a note, never an error. POST /api/evidence/refresh (jason.approvals.evidence.refresh) answers the same shape with refreshed added.

readAt.description: When this copy was read or synced (ISO 8601); empty when unknown.

digest.description: sha256 of what was read; empty when not comparable.

text.description: A citation's words, quoted from disk, never paraphrased; else empty.

changed.description: The plan's read against a later local copy, where comparable; null when it cannot tell.

link.description: The original, where jason can build a link to it; else empty.

live.description: Running it reads an outside system.

system.description: The outside system a live command reads (PayHOA, Google); empty when live is false.

refreshable.description: The one-record live refresh a person may run from the console (POST /api/evidence/refresh): the system it reads and what the button offers; null when the kind has none.

documents.description: The documents behind the evidence a person may open whole (POST /api/evidence/view: unmasked, for a named person, logged): a request's submission and its saved attachments, a citation's whole section and the governing document's file. Names and sizes only, never the contents; empty for a board item or a command.

id.description: What POST /api/evidence/view names as document: "submission", "section", a file name, or an opaque id.

kind.description: From the file's extension alone; HTML, SVG, and XML are file, never shown inline.

readAt.description: When it was read or saved (ISO 8601); empty when unknown.

level.description: Only on a confidential document, listed while the person's private view is open (jason.web.access); its note says so.

refreshed.description: Only on a refresh's answer: when the record was read again, for whom, and from which system.

note.description: Why something is a miss, and the command that fills it.
